claims.statement: All DSS tunables are configured via DSS_-prefixed environment variables loaded through python-dotenv from the project-root .env; the root .env is git-ignored (only .env.example, the committed template, is tracked), and a missing .env is tolerated (load_config and spike_w1/common load_dotenv calls are no-ops, with spike_w1 falling back to plain os.environ if dotenv is absent).

DSSConfig is a frozen dataclass in spike_w3/common.py holding the complete parameter surface (28 fields: driver mode/poll, B3 guardrails, dead vehicle/bootstrap/rebuild, plan folder, alpha family, alert lines, line-stop, dual-ring gates, console/run_tag/snapshot_dir); load_config() builds it from os.environ after load_dotenv, with production defaults for every field.

The strict 1/0 gate discipline (_env_strict01 in spike_w3/common.py and the identical _strict01 in spike_w2/eta_v2.py) returns the default for unset/blank values but raises ValueError naming the variable for any value other than '0' or '1' (e.g. 2, true, on, 1.0, x) — no silent fallback — and tests pin this behavior for load_config, dual_ring_enabled and use_net_delay_enabled.

DSS_DUAL_RING (strict 1/0, default 1) selects the engine: 1 = Doc14 unified engine (137/139 dual-bit + oven trajectory + expected_delay), the production default; 0 = full rollback to the legacy estimate_event path. The gate is read from the environment per call by the live consumption points (predictor.rem_of, dashboard) via dual_ring_enabled(), so it operates independently of the DSSConfig.dual_ring mirror field; DSS_SHIFT_TIER_DELAY has no DSSConfig field at all and is read only via eta_v2.shift_tier_delay_enabled().

DSS_USE_NET_DELAY (strict 1/0, default 1) is effective only when DSS_DUAL_RING=0, where 1 makes the old engine consume expected_delay in place of p×L (doc10 retrofit, estimate_event_net_delay); under DSS_DUAL_RING=1 the unified engine always consumes expected_delay and the parameter is ignored (dual-review B11). The shared replay dispatch estimate_for_replay routes: DUAL_RING=1 → estimate_event_unified, else ND=1 → estimate_event_net_delay, else legacy estimate_event.

Rollback semantics per the M5 runbook: true old-stack rollback is DSS_DUAL_RING=0 AND DSS_USE_NET_DELAY=0; the combination DUAL_RING=0 AND USE_NET_DELAY=1 is a half-migrated degraded state (W4.4f measured 11.00%/11.99%, failed) and must not be used as a rollback.

DSS_SHIFT_TIER_DELAY (strict 1/0, default 0, W4.4h 2026-10-07 decision) only affects the DUAL_RING=1 path: =1 makes the unified engine's delay lookup prefer shift-tier rows of dss.dim_expected_delay_shift with sample attribution from the entry-event shift (fixed bands DAY [04:45,16:30) / MID [16:30,04:45) via entry_shift_of); missing rows/thresholds/missing table fall back to shared rows so default 0 and the fallback path are bit-identical (zero drift). The shift-tier table is optional and deliberately excluded from the required startup table list.

Two-value binding (B4 point 7): when DSS_BOOTSTRAP_HOURS is not explicitly set, bootstrap_hours takes the resolved DSS_DEAD_VEHICLE_HOURS value (detected via _env_float_opt), while an explicit DSS_BOOTSTRAP_HOURS always wins; defaults are 120h for both.

B3/M4 guardrail and self-healing thresholds: DSS_STALE_MIN=30 (no events >30min → data-cut circuit breaker; ETL SLA 2026-09-23: intranet owner, RTO ≤1h, outage periods excluded from the acceptance gate), DSS_LAG_MIN=15 (lag observation state), DSS_SKEW_WINDOW_MIN=15 (out-of-order tolerance), DSS_DEAD_VEHICLE_HOURS=120 (dead vehicle), DSS_REBUILD_HOURS=24 (periodic full rebuild = F-1 dropped-row/watermark-poisoning self-healing ceiling).

DSS_PLAN_FOLDER (default plan_inbox) is the weekly-plan input folder per the 2026-09-23 user decision (in-repo plan_inbox/ is the development default; production overrides only the path, the week_plan_YYYYKWww*.csv naming convention unchanged); no files, all-parse-fail, or cross-file conflict degrades to fallback self-learn mode (shift inferred, no targets).

The α family defaults are DSS_ALPHA_MODE=off (user decision 2026-09-25: production default off, M9 gate judged at α=off), DSS_ALPHA_WINDOW_HOURS=3, DSS_ALPHA_MIN_SAMPLES=30, DSS_ALPHA_EMA_BETA=0.3, DSS_ALPHA_CLAMP_MIN=0.6, DSS_ALPHA_CLAMP_MAX=1.5, DSS_ETA_STALE_HOURS=6 (L4 stale: marked only, still counts toward prediction), DSS_LEARN_WIN_START=2026-04-14 / DSS_LEARN_WIN_END=2026-08-15 (W1 learning window, no future leakage); DSS_ALPHA_MODE accepts on/off case-insensitively and raises ValueError otherwise, and the α hysteresis (0.05 / 2 cycles) is a code-level constant deliberately not exposed as env.

Gap-alert thresholds (Task 4, user decision 2026-09-23 — lines went live as-is with a 5-day shadow period observing false-positive rate): DSS_ALERT_RED=-0.10 (gap exceeds 10% vs target), DSS_ALERT_YELLOW=-0.05, DSS_ALERT_DEBOUNCE_MIN=10 (alert fires only after persisting at that level for 10 minutes).

Line-stop detection (Task 5, mode A) thresholds: DSS_LINE_STOP_MIN=30 (backbone key-station no-event trigger) and DSS_OBSERVE_MIN=15 (observation state — pre-attention marking without a line-stop alarm).

DSS_CONSOLE (default 1, T6) uses lenient parsing — 1/true/on and 0/false/off case-insensitively — which is wider than the strict 1/0 contract but still raises ValueError on other values (documented as different from _env_strict01); 0 disables the 5-minute console frame and snapshot writing (regression baseline), and console assembly failure never blocks the main loop (it is an accessory; a [T6] WARNING is printed and the loop continues).

DSS_RUN_TAG (default empty) controls the snapshot run tag: empty → auto-generated YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS, with auto tags bumped -r2/-r3 when the directory already holds snap_* files (overwrite protection); an explicit tag is an idempotent append into the same directory across restarts (M5 prep agy block F3). DSS_SNAPSHOT_DIR defaults to output/snapshots, which is git-ignored for high-frequency snapshot留痕.

The DSN override mechanism: _dsn() in spike_w1/common.py is a pure function mapping DSS_DB_HOST/PORT/NAME/USER/PASSWORD to psycopg2 kwargs with development-DB defaults (port cast to int) when unset; connect() re-parses _dsn() fresh on every call so DSS_DB_* changes take effect at runtime rather than being frozen at module import (fix for M5 prep agy block F1), and sets autocommit plus session TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'. spike_w3 re-exports connect from spike_w1/common.py (loaded as the w1_common module alias to avoid the common.py name clash), and credential values stay in the local untracked .env only.

M9 shadow-replay debug switches consumed directly by 02_shadow_replay (off = production semantics): DSS_M9_START/DSS_M9_END default to 2026-09-05T00:00 / 2026-09-13T23:59:59 (KW36/37, ISO, CST); DSS_SELF_CHECK_BAND='lo,hi' overrides the Step-A self-check fixed band (code default [0.1089, 0.1339], D5(a) re-anchor 2026-10-06) with strict validation (0<lo<hi<1, else ValueError at startup); DSS_M9_CROSS_MACHINE/DSS_M9_CROSS_DIR point the cross-check machine at scratch/02_replay_kw37.py and output/tmp_kw37_review by default.

replay_cursor mode requires DSS_REPLAY_START/DSS_REPLAY_END (ISO), otherwise main() raises SystemExit; the replay bootstrap anchors to the replay start (not wall clock) so the watermark is the replay window's max row ID and the incremental stream does not run dry; DSS_PLAN_CSV switches plan loading to single-file mode (replay dry-run override) instead of directory merge; DSS_G4_HARD=1 restores the M9 G4 hard gate (softened by default; only meaningful with DSS_ALPHA_MODE=on).

Polling behavior: the wall_clock main loop sleeps to the next poll grid point via next_grid_wait (drift-compensated epoch-grid alignment, floor 1.0s, so frame timestamps land on the 5-minute grid — M5 anchor-frame matching, agy block F2), while the replay_cursor loop advances its cursor by poll_interval_sec (default 300, debug replay 1–5).

Startup-report DoD: bootstrap() stores config_echo = dataclasses.asdict(cfg) on BootstrapReport and render_boot_report prints every effective DSSConfig value (sorted k=v line) together with plan, dim-table, pool, watermark, cross-check and freshness status, so an operator always sees the exact parameter set running with no hidden fallbacks.
